hypothesised_pattern: Target class is class_2 when x4^2 - 0.25 exceeds about 1.85*|x2*x5|, and otherwise follows the sign of x2*x5, with an apparent small rate of label noise.
functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.25 > 1.85*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: Nine of ten examples fit the rule. Idx 5 is the miss: it is class 1 with x2*x5 of about -2.5, far from the boundary, so the rule strongly predicts class 0. It is the only strong counterexample among the many samples checked, so I treat it as likely label noise, though a smaller unmodelled effect cannot be ruled out.
